title: The Collins Elite as a fundamentalist faction inside government

tellings.quote: describe the Collins elite as this sort of uh very embedded in the government faction of of deeply fundamentalist Christians who don't want to study this stuff scientifically at all because they view it as demonic

plain: The Collins Elite is said to be a faction of deeply fundamentalist Christians embedded in the US government who see UFOs as demonic and do not want them studied scientifically. Michels relays this from Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official, and from To The Stars Academy, a private company set up to research UFOs. If true, it would mean that religious belief, not only secrecy, has kept the subject from serious study inside government.
